SupervisionCausalParent.title: SupervisionCausalParent
SupervisionCausalParent.description: Causal parent of a supervision event: an earlier event in the same supervision stream (the W010 shape).

SupervisionStreamId.title: SupervisionStreamId
SupervisionStreamId.description: Opaque supervision-stream identity: "stream:supervision-<suffix>" (one stream per supervised program).

SupervisionEventSequence.title: SupervisionEventSequence
SupervisionEventSequence.description: One supervision-event sequence number: 1-based, contiguous per supervision stream.
